title: Apollo 1
contributing_factors: 100% oxygen at 16.7 psia|Combustible materials near possible ignition sources|Difficult emergency egress
operational_consequences: Rapid fire spread|Toxic atmosphere|Pressure increase and vessel rupture
response_actions: Ground emergency response|Subsequent spacecraft and procedure redesign
research_focus: Atmosphere and combustible materials|Ignition and wiring|Evacuation and equipment access
psi_relation_note: BASS-II supports controlled research questions about material flammability, oxygen concentration, airflow, and ignition. It does not reproduce the Apollo 1 ground-test conditions.
interpretation_limit: Ground-test accident; not microgravity flame-spread evidence. Its oxygen condition is outside the BASS-II/SIBAL prototype range and must not be used as a comparable record or probability label.
source_title: Report of the Apollo 204 Review Board

title: Mir Fire
operational_consequences: Dense smoke|One Soyuz evacuation route blocked
response_actions: Oxygen masks|Foam extinguishers|Crew coordination|Life-support smoke removal
research_focus: Smoke and fire detection|Evacuation and equipment access|System failure and recovery
psi_relation_note: SAME supports research questions about smoke particles and detector response in low gravity. It is not a reconstruction of the Mir fire.
interpretation_limit: Historical operational incident; not a structured SAME detector trial and not a measurement of particle-size distribution, detector sensitivity, or flame-spread rate.
source_title: 25 Years Ago Fire Aboard Space Station Mir

title: Apollo 13
contributing_factors: Prior component damage|Heater overtemperature|Probable Teflon insulation damage|Short circuit and combustion event
operational_consequences: Loss of oxygen|Loss of fuel-cell electrical generation|Mission abort
response_actions: Lunar Module used as refuge|Resource conservation|Mission Control coordination
research_focus: Ignition and wiring|System failure and recovery
psi_relation_note: No BASS-II or SAME record is treated as an experimental match. The case provides systems-resilience context only.
interpretation_limit: Oxygen-system failure and combustion event; not a cabin-fire experiment and not a valid label for ignition, flame spread, detector response, or accident probability.
source_title: 50 Years Ago Apollo 13 Review Board Report
